description: PAID $0.003 USDC. Every Hyperliquid spot market: mark/mid, 24h change, volume and supply, from the official public info API. Research data, not investment advice. Params coin, limit. Covered by pass_day/pass_month. No charge on failure. Returns JSON for Hyperliquid spot markets: mark or mid, 24h change, volume, and supply.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

coin.description: Optional spot pair or token filter. Format: a token symbol or PAIR/USDC. Example: HYPE. Another example already in the tool text: PURR/USDC. Omit for the whole book.

limit.description: Maximum markets, ordered by 24h volume. Format: positive integer. Example: 20. Default: all markets, as the existing tool text states.

name: hl_spot
